{{Conjecture|legends}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] maintained a well-[[Armor/Legends|armored]] '''safehouse''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]].<ref name="guide">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref>

The safehouse was located among the rocky foothills of the [[Kurual'grast Mountains]], outside of [[Drev'starn]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]].<ref name="guide" />

The building was the [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|intelligence]] headquarters and operations center for the [[Bothan Space/Legends|sector]], gathering information from the planet, either by hired [[spy/Legends|spies]], or sympathizers. Experts who processed usable information, presented it to mission planners, and sometimes began further investigation.<ref name="guide" />

It was equipped with spying and intelligence-gathering or encryption devices, [[supercomputers]], gadgets and forged documents, some of them developed by staff [[technician/Legends|technicans]] in a makeshift laboratory. There was also a rich arsenal of non-lethal weapons (complying with the planet's laws), with a few exceptions.<ref name="guide" />

There were resting commodities for transient [[agent/Legends|agents]], such as a firing range, gym, and even a [[sauna/Legends|sauna]].<ref name="guide" />
